RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, July 27, 2010/Sravana 5, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Civil Aviation; Finance; Health and Family Welfare; Heavy
Industries and Public Enterprises; Panchayati Raj; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Rural Development; Shipping)
Total number of questions — 20
7
Sale of shares of Public Sector Banks
*21. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that some of the
Public Sector Banks are going to sell their
shares to the public during this fiscal year;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government had assessed
the market about the sale price of the shares;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether Government has decided
the sale of banks' shares on auction basis;
(f) if so, the details thereof; and
(g) if not, the reasons therefor?
Decontrol of petro-products' prices
*22. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has decided to decontrol the prices of the
petroleum products;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) whether it is also a fact that it will
lead to monopoly of the oil companies?
Disbursement of credit to private and
public sector undertakings
*23. SHRI RAJEEV
CHANDRASEKHAR: Will the Minister
of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) the total gross new credit disbursed
during 2008-09 and 2009-10 by various
banks to private and public sector
undertakings (PSUs) separately, year-wise
and sector-wise; and
(b) how much of the credit to the private
sector was linked to the Government or
PSUs risk/contracts?
Implementation of MGNREGS
*24. PROF. ANIL KUMAR SAHANI:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether only 42, 48 and 51 days
per household of employment on an
average could be provided to the job seeking
households under Mahatma Gandhi
National Rural Employment Guarantee

8
Scheme (MGNREGS) during 2007-08,
2008-09 and 2009-10 respectively;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether only 9 per cent of
households were provided 100 days
employment during 2009-10 under the
Scheme;
(d) the steps taken to provide more
funds to the Scheme to achieve its intended
objectives;
(e) whether funds meant for the Scheme
have been diverted and used for other
purposes; and
(f) if so, the details thereof and the action
taken against the unscrupulous officials?
Price hike of petroleum products
*25. SHRI PRABHAT JHA: Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has increased
the prices of petrol, diesel, kerosene and
Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) recently;
(b) if so, the details of increase, item-
wise;
(c) the details of price hike of petroleum
products during the last fourteen months
till date, item-wise;
(d) whether this price rise would lead
to increase in inflation and price rise of
essential commodities which is already very
high; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and the
corrective measures taken or to be taken in
this regard?
Surging inflation rate
*26. SHRI N.K. SINGH: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the plight of the common
man reeling under the impact of rising prices
has worsened with the inflation rate surging
into double digits recently;
(b) if so, whether the various strategies
and policies of Government have
completely failed to contain the rising
prices;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the details of new initiatives
Government proposes to take to control
or check inflation?
Air mishaps in the country
†*27. SHRI A VINASH RAI
KHANNA: Will the Minister of CIVIL
A VIA TION be pleased to state:
(a) the number of air mishaps and the
details of losses incurred therein during the
last three years;
(b) whether any investigation has been
conducted for Mangalore air mishap;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the action being taken by
Government to prevent recurrence of such
mishaps?
New world class airports in the
country
*28. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will the
Minister  of CIVIL  A VIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government has taken a
decision of making new world class Indian
airports, like Delhi T-3, global aviation hubs
giving an impetus to the Aviation Ministry's
long delayed proposal of allowing foreign
airlines to take up to 26 per cent stake in
domestic carrier;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and

(c) if not, by when a final decision
would be taken?

to be started from there on 31 July, 2010;
(b) whether it is a fact that now date of
operation has been fixed as 27 August, 2010;
